sources.title: CladeTeam/CENO-P-300M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: CENO-P-300M is the multi-species alignment (MSA) post-trained variant of the 300M CENO DNA foundation model, for variant effect prediction (VEP). It carries intra_encoding_pattern in its config and ships the MSA scoring path (modeling_ceno_p.py), which consumes a per-token seq_idx to score packed MSA inputs.
